1.word_for_word: राज-प्रश्नोत्तरं वक्ष्यन् ब्रह्मणे हरिणोदितम् । — After explaining the answer to the king’s questions, Lord Hari told the brāhmaṇa.; कथयाम् आस नवमे शुको भागवतं पुनः ॥ — In the ninth incarnation, Śukadeva Gosvāmī continued to recite the Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam.; तत्र यत् तावद् उक्तं यद् अधातुमतः इत्य् अनेन जीवस्य कथं देह-सम्बन्ध इति तत्रोत्तरम् आह । — What has been said so far is that it is of the non-metallic nature, and how does this have a relationship with the body of the living entity?; आत्मनो हरेर् मायाम् अन्तरेणानुभव-रूपस्यात्मनोरथेन दृश्येन देहादिना सम्बन्धोऽञ्जसा तत्त्वतो न घटेत । — Without the illusory energy of the Supreme Personality of Godhead, the Supreme Personality of Godhead, who is in the form of experience, cannot easily become connected with the body, which is visible to Him.; अत्र हेतुः—परस्येति । — The reason here is that of the other.; स्वप्न-द्रष्टुर् यथा स्वप्न-देह-सम्बन्धो न घटते तद्वत् ॥१॥ — Just as the dreamer does not have the relationship between the dream and the body.
1.translation: After explaining the answer to the king’s questions, Lord Hari told the brāhmaṇa. In the ninth incarnation, Śukadeva Gosvāmī continued to recite the Śrīmad-Bhāgavatam. What has been said so far is that it is of the non-metallic nature, and how does this have a relationship with the body of the living entity? Without the illusory energy of the Supreme Personality of Godhead, the Supreme Personality of Godhead, who is in the form of experience, cannot easily become connected with the body, which is visible to Him. The reason here is that of the other. Just as the dreamer does not have the relationship between the dream and the body.

2.word_for_word: संसारोऽपि माययैवेत्य् आह । — He argues that the world is also illusory.; बहु-रूपो बाल-युवादि-रूपो देव-नरादि-रूपश् चाभाति । — He appears in many forms, such as children, young men, gods, men and others.; गुणेषु देहादिषु ॥२॥ — in the modes of nature, such as the body.
2.translation: He argues that the world is also illusory. He appears in many forms, such as children, young men, gods, men and others. in the modes of nature, such as the body.

3.word_for_word: अत एव भक्ति-योगेन तन्-निरासे सति मोक्षोऽपि घटत इत्य् आह—यर्हीति । — That is why, he argues, when one is disappointed by the yoga of devotion, even liberation occurs.; वाव-शब्द एवार्थे । — in the same sense as the word vav.; स्व एव महिम्नि यदा रमेत । — When he enjoys his own glory.; तद् एवाह । — That’s what he said.; काल-माययोः पुरुष-प्रकृत्योः परस्मिन् । — Beyond the nature of man and time and illusion.; तदोभयम् अहं ममेति च त्यक्त्वा उदास्ते पूर्ण-रूपेणावतिष्ठते ॥३॥ — Then, having abandoned both, thinking that I am mine, he remains in the fullness of the self.
3.translation: That is why, he argues, when one is disappointed by the yoga of devotion, even liberation occurs. in the same sense as the word vav. When he enjoys his own glory. That’s what he said. Beyond the nature of man and time and illusion. Then, having abandoned both, thinking that I am mine, he remains in the fullness of the self.

4.word_for_word: यच् चोक्तं परमेश्वरस्यापि देह-सम्बन्धाविशेषात् कथं तद्-भक्त्या मोक्षः स्याद् इति ... तत्राह—आत्मनो जीवस्य तत्त्व-विशुद्ध्य्-अर्थं तत्त्व-ज्ञानार्थं तद् भवत्य् एव । — What has been said about how liberation can be attained by devotion to God, even from the special relationship of the body ... He argues that it is for the purification of the essence of the soul and for the knowledge of the essence.; ... ऋतं सत्यं चिद्-घनं रूपं दर्शयन् । — ... showing the form of the truth, the truth, the consciousness-dense.; दर्शने हेतुः—अव्यलीकेन व्रतेन तपसा आदृतः सेवितः सन् । — The reason for seeing—being respected and served by unfailing vows and austerities.; अयं भावः—जीवस्याविद्यया मिथ्या-रूप-देह-सम्बन्धः, ईश्वरस्य तु योगमायया चिद्-घन-लीला-विग्रहाविर्भाव इति महान् विशेषः ॥४॥ — This is the great difference between the living entity’s relationship with the body and its false form through ignorance, while the Supreme Personality of Godhead, by His illusory energy, manifests Himself in the form of a dense pastime and conflict.
4.translation: What has been said about how liberation can be attained by devotion to God, even from the special relationship of the body ... He argues that it is for the purification of the essence of the soul and for the knowledge of the essence. ... showing the form of the truth, the truth, the consciousness-dense. The reason for seeing—being respected and served by unfailing vows and austerities. This is the great difference between the living entity’s relationship with the body and its false form through ignorance, while the Supreme Personality of Godhead, by His illusory energy, manifests Himself in the form of a dense pastime and conflict.

5.word_for_word: भगवद्-भजनाद् एव तत्त्व-ज्ञानम् इत्य् एतत् प्रपञ्चयिष्यन् ब्रह्मणोऽपि तत्त्व-ज्ञानं तत्-प्रसादाद् एवेति दर्शयितुम् इतिहासम् आह—स इत्य्-आदिना । — In order to argue that knowledge of the truth is due to worship of the Supreme Personality of Godhead, he argues that even the knowledge of the truth is due to the grace of the Supreme Personality of Godhead.; परो गुरुर् भक्ति-रहस्योपदेष्टा । — The Supreme Guru is the teacher of the mysteries of devotion.; स्वधिष्ण्यं पद्मम् आस्थाय अधिष्ठाय ... ऐक्षत तत् कथं स्रष्टव्यम् इत्य् आलोचितवान् । — He sat down on the lotus in his seat ... and looked at it and discussed how to create it.; तां दृशं प्रज्ञाम् अत्र सृष्टि-विषये संमताम् अव्यभिचारिणीम् । — That visible wisdom here is infallible, agreed upon in the matter of creation.; विधिः प्रकारः ॥५॥ — The method is the type.
5.translation: In order to argue that knowledge of the truth is due to worship of the Supreme Personality of Godhead, he argues that even the knowledge of the truth is due to the grace of the Supreme Personality of Godhead. The Supreme Guru is the teacher of the mysteries of devotion. He sat down on the lotus in his seat ... and looked at it and discussed how to create it. That visible wisdom here is infallible, agreed upon in the matter of creation. The method is the type.

6.word_for_word: सृष्टिं चिन्तयन् कदाचित् द्व्य्-अक्षरं वचोऽम्भसि उपाशृणोत् उप समीपे श्रुतवान् । — Once, while contemplating creation, he heard a two-syllable word in the water, which he heard nearby.; ते अक्षरे दर्शयति । — They show in the letter.; कादयो मावसानाः स्पर्शाः तेषु यत् षोडशं त-कारो यच् चैकविंशं प-कारः ... निष्किंचनानां त्यक्त-धनानां धनं ... तच् च द्विर्-गदितं तप तपेति । — The sixteenth t-card and the twenty-first p-card in them are the touches of the months, beginning with ka.; लोट्-मध्य-पुरुषैकवचनम् ॥६॥ — Lot-middle-person singular.
6.translation: Once, while contemplating creation, he heard a two-syllable word in the water, which he heard nearby. They show in the letter. The sixteenth t-card and the twenty-first p-card in them are the touches of the months, beginning with ka. Lot-middle-person singular.

7.word_for_word: एवं निशम्य तस्य वचसो वक्तुर् दिदृक्षया ततः प्रचलितः सन् दिशो विलोक्य पुनः स्वधिष्ण्यम् आस्थाय केनचित् प्रत्यक्षं नियुक्त इव तच् चात्मनो हितं विमृश्य तपसि मनो धृतवान् इत्य् अर्थः ॥७॥ — Having thus heard the words of the speaker, desiring to see him, he moved about, looked in all directions, and again took his seat, as if directly appointed by someone, and having considered the welfare of himself, he fixed his mind on austerities, that is to say.
7.translation: Having thus heard the words of the speaker, desiring to see him, he moved about, looked in all directions, and again took his seat, as if directly appointed by someone, and having considered the welfare of himself, he fixed his mind on austerities, that is to say.

8.word_for_word: ततश् च स ब्रह्मा अखिलानां लोकानां तापनं प्रकाशकं तपोऽतप्यत स्म कृतवान् । — Then that Brahma performed austerities that heated and illuminated the entire world.; तप तपेत्य् एतस्य वचसोऽर्थे । — The meaning of this word is to perform austerities.; अमोघं दर्शनं यस्य । — whose vision is infallible.; जितोऽनिल आत्मा मनश् च येन । — He who has conquered the air, the soul and the mind.; विजितान्य् उभयेन्द्रियाणि ज्ञान-कर्मात्मकानि येन तपतां तपश्-चरतां मध्ये तपीयान् अतिशयेन तपस्वी ॥८॥ — He who has conquered both the senses consisting of knowledge and action performs great austerities in the midst of those who practice austerities.
8.translation: Then that Brahma performed austerities that heated and illuminated the entire world. The meaning of this word is to perform austerities. whose vision is infallible. He who has conquered the air, the soul and the mind. He who has conquered both the senses consisting of knowledge and action performs great austerities in the midst of those who practice austerities.

9.word_for_word: तस्मै ब्रह्मणे स्व-लोकं वैकुण्ठाख्यम् । — For that Brahman, his own world is called Vaikuṇṭha.; परं श्रेष्ठम् । — But it’s the best.; न यत्-परं यतः परम् उत्कृष्टम् अन्यन् नास्ति । — There is nothing else that is superior to what is beyond that.; तम् एव लोकम् अनुवर्णयति पञ्चभिः । — He describes the same world in five ways.; व्यपेताः संक्लेशादयो यस्मात् । — Because of which the troubles and other things are overcome.; स्व-दृष्टवद्भिः सत्-पुण्यवद्भिः । — By those who have seen themselves as true and pious.; यद् वा, स्वस्य दृष्टं दर्शनम् अस्ति येषाम्, आत्म-विद्भिर् इत्य् अर्थः ॥९॥ — or, that is, by those who have seen the vision of themselves, by the self-knowers.
9.translation: For that Brahman, his own world is called Vaikuṇṭha. But it’s the best. There is nothing else that is superior to what is beyond that. He describes the same world in five ways. Because of which the troubles and other things are overcome. By those who have seen themselves as true and pious. or, that is, by those who have seen the vision of themselves, by the self-knowers.

10.word_for_word: तयोस् ताभ्यां मिश्रं सत्त्वं च न प्रवर्तते, किन्तु शुद्धम् एव सत्त्वम् । — There is no mixture of the two and the Sattva, but the pure Sattva.; काल-विक्रमो नाशः । — The triumph of time is destruction.; अपरे राग-लोभादयो न सन्तीति, किम् उ वक्तव्यम् । — What is to be said about the fact that there are no others, such as passion and greed?; अनुव्रताः पार्षदाः ॥१०॥ — They followed the attendants.
10.translation: There is no mixture of the two and the Sattva, but the pure Sattva. The triumph of time is destruction. What is to be said about the fact that there are no others, such as passion and greed? They followed the attendants.

11.word_for_word: श्यामाश् च ते अवदाता उज्ज्वलाश् च, पद्म-नेत्राः, पीताम्बराः, सुरुचोऽतिकमनीयाः, सुपेशसोऽतिसुकुमाराः । — They were dark and bright, with lotus-eyes, dressed in yellow, very beautiful in appearance, and very delicate in body.; उन्मिषन्त इव प्रभावन्तो मणि-प्रवेका मण्य्-उत्तमा येषु तानि निष्काणि पदकान्य् आभरणानि च येषां ते । — They seemed to be blinking, and they were as impressive as the gems, which were the best of the gems, and they were the ones who wore those coins, medals and ornaments.; सुवर्चसोऽतितेजस्विनः ... ॥११॥ — They are very bright and very bright ... ॥11॥
11.translation: They were dark and bright, with lotus-eyes, dressed in yellow, very beautiful in appearance, and very delicate in body. They seemed to be blinking, and they were as impressive as the gems, which were the best of the gems, and they were the ones who wore those coins, medals and ornaments. They are very bright and very bright ... ॥11॥

12.word_for_word: प्रवालादिवद् वर्चो वर्णो येषां ते, परितः स्फुरन्ति कुण्डलानि मौलयो मालाश् च सन्ति येषां ते ॥११॥ — Those whose complexion is like that of corals and whose earrings and garlands glitter all around them.
12.translation: Those whose complexion is like that of corals and whose earrings and garlands glitter all around them.

13.word_for_word: पार्षदान् अनुवर्ण्य पुनर् अपि लोकम् अनुवर्णयति । — After describing his associates, he again describes the world.; भ्राजिष्णुभिर् देदीप्यमानाभिः प्रमदोत्तमानां दिवः कान्तयस् ताभिर् विद्योतमानः । — The heavens were illuminated by the glittering lights of the best of women.; सह विद्युद्भिर् वर्तमानाः स-विद्युतस् ताभिर् अभ्रावलिभिः । — They were present with the lightning and the lightning with those clouds; तत्र विद्युत इव स्त्रियः, अभ्रपङ्क्तय इव विमानानि, नभ इव लोकः ॥१२॥ — There are women like lightning, rows of clouds like airplanes, and the world like the sky.
13.translation: After describing his associates, he again describes the world. The heavens were illuminated by the glittering lights of the best of women. They were present with the lightning and the lightning with those clouds There are women like lightning, rows of clouds like airplanes, and the world like the sky.

14.word_for_word: श्रीः सम्पत् । — Shri: Wealth.; रूपिणी मूर्तिमती । — Rupini Murtimati.; मानं पूजाम् । — Honor and worship.; विभूतिभिर् नाना-विभवैः प्रेङ्खम् आन्दोलं संश्रिता । — She is surrounded by various glories and powers; कुसुमाकरो वसन्तः, तस्यानुगा भ्रमराः, तैर् विविधं गीयमाना । — Spring is the flowering season, and the bees follow it, singing in various ways.; स्वयं तु प्रियस्य हरेः कर्म गायन्तीव भवति ॥१३॥ — She herself seems to be singing the deeds of her beloved Hari.
14.translation: Shri: Wealth. Rupini Murtimati. Honor and worship. She is surrounded by various glories and powers Spring is the flowering season, and the bees follow it, singing in various ways. She herself seems to be singing the deeds of her beloved Hari.

15.word_for_word: य एवम्भूतो लोकस् तत्र तस्मिन् ॥१४॥ — The world which is thus formed is there in that.
15.translation: The world which is thus formed is there in that.

16.word_for_word: भृत्यानां प्रसादोऽभिमुखम्, दृग् एव आसव इव द्रष्टॄणां हर्ष-करी यस्य तम्, प्रसन्न-हासम् अरुण-लोचनं चाननं यस्य, वक्षसि स्थितया च श्रिया लक्षितम्, अलंकृतम् इत्य् अर्थः ॥१५॥ — The grace of His servants is facing Him, His gaze is like the breath of life that brings joy to those who see Him, His face is adorned with a cheerful smile and red eyes, and is marked and adorned with the beauty that stands on His chest.
16.translation: The grace of His servants is facing Him, His gaze is like the breath of life that brings joy to those who see Him, His face is adorned with a cheerful smile and red eyes, and is marked and adorned with the beauty that stands on His chest.

17.word_for_word: अध्यर्हणीयं वरिष्ठं सिंहासनम् । — The throne is the senior throne to be worshipped.; चतस्रः प्रकृति-पुरुष-महद्-अहंकार-रूपाः, षोडश एकादशेन्द्रिय-पञ्च-महाभूताख्याः पञ्च-तन्मात्र-रूपा याः शक्तयस् ताभिर् वृतम् । — The four forms of nature, the person, the great ego, and the sixteen and eleven senses, the five great beings, and the five forms of the five elements are surrounded by these energies.; स्वैर् भगैः स्वाभाविकैर् ऐश्वर्यादिभिः इतरत्र योगिश्व् अध्रुवैर् आगन्तुकैः । — The yogi’s own natural fortunes, such as wealth and other things, are impermanent and come to him elsewhere.; साधारणैर् इत्य् अर्थः । — It means by the ordinary.; एवं सत्य् अपि स्व एव धामन् स्व-स्वरूप एव रममाणम् । — Thus, even though it is true, it is still in its own right, and it is still enjoying itself in its own form.; अत एवेश्वरम् ॥१६॥ — That is why it is the Lord.
17.translation: The throne is the senior throne to be worshipped. The four forms of nature, the person, the great ego, and the sixteen and eleven senses, the five great beings, and the five forms of the five elements are surrounded by these energies. The yogi’s own natural fortunes, such as wealth and other things, are impermanent and come to him elsewhere. It means by the ordinary. Thus, even though it is true, it is still in its own right, and it is still enjoying itself in its own form. That is why it is the Lord.

18.word_for_word: तस्य दर्शनेन य आह्लादस् तेन परिप्लुतं व्याप्तम् आन्तरम् अन्तःकरणं यस्य। — whose inner consciousness is pervaded by the joy of seeing Him.; हृष्यन्ती रोमाञ्चिता तनुर् यस्य । — His body is cheerful and excited.; प्रेम-भरेणाश्रूणि लोचनेषु यस्य । — whose eyes are filled with tears of love.; विश्व-सृक् ब्रह्मा । — Brahma, the creator of the universe.; पारमहंस्येन पथा ज्ञान-मार्गेण ॥१७॥ — The path of the Paramahansa is the path of knowledge.
18.translation: whose inner consciousness is pervaded by the joy of seeing Him. His body is cheerful and excited. whose eyes are filled with tears of love. Brahma, the creator of the universe. The path of the Paramahansa is the path of knowledge.

19.word_for_word: तं ब्रह्माणं भगवान् बभाषे । — The Supreme Personality of Godhead addressed that Brahmā.; प्रजा-विसर्गे कार्ये निज-शासनार्हणं स्व-नियोगार्हम् । — He deserves his own rule in the work of creating the people and his own employment.; प्रजा-विसर्गे समुपस्थितम् इति वान्वयः । — It is consequently present in the creation of the people.; ईषत्-स्मितेन शोचिर् दीप्तिः शोभा यस्यास् तया गिरा ॥१८॥ — With a slight smile she was sorrowful and radiant and beautiful with her words.
19.translation: The Supreme Personality of Godhead addressed that Brahmā. He deserves his own rule in the work of creating the people and his own employment. It is consequently present in the creation of the people. With a slight smile she was sorrowful and radiant and beautiful with her words.

20.word_for_word: सिसृक्षया हेतुना चिरं सम्भृतेन तपसाहं सम्यक् तोषितः । — I was perfectly satisfied with my long-standing austerities for the sake of creation.; दुस्तोषस् तोषयितुम् अशक्यः ॥१९॥ — The unsatisfied is impossible to satisfy.
20.translation: I was perfectly satisfied with my long-standing austerities for the sake of creation. The unsatisfied is impossible to satisfy.

21.word_for_word: मा इति माम् । — Don’t tell me.; श्रेयसां फलानां परि-श्रामः परिश्रमः साधन-प्रयासः मम दर्शनम् अवधिर् यस्य स तथा । — The period of the best fruits is the exertion, the effort, the means, the effort, the vision of Me, and the period of time.; अतोऽधिकं तु पुनः फलं नास्तीत्य् अर्थः ॥२०॥ — This means that there is no reward greater than this.
21.translation: Don’t tell me. The period of the best fruits is the exertion, the effort, the means, the effort, the vision of Me, and the period of time. This means that there is no reward greater than this.

22.word_for_word: एतच् च मत्-कृपयैव त्वया प्राप्तम् इत्य् आह । — And this is what you have obtained by my grace, he said.; मनीषितम् इच्छा तुभ्यम् इदं दातव्यम् इति या ममेच्छा तस्यानुभावोऽयम् । — This is the power of My desire to give you this, which I have intended.; कोऽसौ तम् आह । — Who is he, he asked him?; मम लोकस्यावलोकनं यत् । — That’s a look at my world.; न चेदं मयैव तपो-बलेन प्राप्तम् इति स्वातन्त्र्यं मन्यस्व तत्-प्रवृत्तेर् अपि मत्-कृतत्वाद् इत्य् आह । — If you do not think that you have attained this freedom by the strength of your austerities, you should consider it to be freedom, since even the instinct for it is due to Me.”; रहसि तप तपेति यद् वच उपश्रुत्य परमं तपश् चकर्थ कृतवान् असि ॥२१॥ — Having heard the words 'You are performing austerities in secret' you have performed supreme austerities
22.translation: And this is what you have obtained by my grace, he said. This is the power of My desire to give you this, which I have intended. Who is he, he asked him? That’s a look at my world. If you do not think that you have attained this freedom by the strength of your austerities, you should consider it to be freedom, since even the instinct for it is due to Me.” Having heard the words 'You are performing austerities in secret' you have performed supreme austerities

23.word_for_word: तद् अपि त्वं प्रति मयैवादिष्टम् उपदिष्टम् । — That is also what I have taught you.; कदा ? — When?; तत्र तदा सृष्ट्य्-आरम्भे त्वयि कर्मणि कार्येऽर्थे विमोहिते सति । — There, at the beginning of creation, you were confused about the meaning of your action.; किं च, तपो नाम ममैव शक्तिर् इत्य् आह—तपो मे हृदयम् अन्तरङ्गा शक्तिः, आत्मा स्वरूपम् । — Moreover, he argues that austerity is My own power—my heart is my innermost power, and my soul is my form.; यस्य ज्ञानमयं तपः इति श्रुतेः ॥२२॥ — whose austerities are full of knowledge, according to the scriptures.
23.translation: That is also what I have taught you. When? There, at the beginning of creation, you were confused about the meaning of your action. Moreover, he argues that austerity is My own power—my heart is my innermost power, and my soul is my form. whose austerities are full of knowledge, according to the scriptures.

24.word_for_word: ग्रसामि संहरामि । — I swallow and destroy.; बिभर्मि पालयामि । — I carry and nurture.; वीर्यं शक्तिः ॥२३॥ — Semen is the power.
24.translation: I swallow and destroy. I carry and nurture. Semen is the power.

25.word_for_word: अध्यक्षोऽधिष्ठाता । — The president is the presiding officer.; गुहां गुहायां बुद्धाव् अवस्थितः सन् यद्य् अपि वेद तथापीत्य् उत्तरेणान्वयः ॥२४॥ — The consequence of the latter is that even if he knows that he is situated in the cave in the cave of the Buddha.
25.translation: The president is the presiding officer. The consequence of the latter is that even if he knows that he is situated in the cave in the cave of the Buddha.

26.word_for_word: नाथमानस्य याचमानस्योपतप्यमानस्येति वा । — Or, if you are a master, you are a beggar, you are a tormentor.; हे नाथ, नाथय आशंसय प्रयच्छ । — O Lord, Lord, grant me hope.; नाथितं याचितम् । — Nathitam asked for it.; नाथितम् एवाह—परं सूक्ष्मम् अवरं स्थूलं च ते रूपं यथा जानीयाम् ॥२५॥ — He said to Nathita: “How can I know Your form, the higher, the lower and the gross?
26.translation: Or, if you are a master, you are a beggar, you are a tormentor. O Lord, Lord, grant me hope. Nathitam asked for it. He said to Nathita: “How can I know Your form, the higher, the lower and the gross?

27.word_for_word: यथा च त्वं क्रीडसि, तथा तद्-विषयां मनीषां मयि धेहि इत्य् उत्तरेणान्वयः। — And as you play, so give me the mind about it, is the consequence of the answer.; नाना-शक्त्य्-उपबृंहितं विश्वं विलुम्पन् संहरन्, विविधं सृजन्, बिभ्रत् पालयन्, आत्मना स्वयम् एव आत्मानं ब्रह्मादि-रूपं गृह्णन् क्रीडसि । — You play with the universe, which is expanded by various energies, destroying it, creating it in various ways, carrying it and maintaining it, and assuming the form of Brahmā and others by Yourself.; ऊर्णुते तन्तुभिर् आत्मानम् आच्छादयति ॥२६-२७॥ — It spreads out and covers itself with fibers (26-27).
27.translation: And as you play, so give me the mind about it, is the consequence of the answer. You play with the universe, which is expanded by various energies, destroying it, creating it in various ways, carrying it and maintaining it, and assuming the form of Brahmā and others by Yourself. It spreads out and covers itself with fibers (26-27).

28.word_for_word: यथा च त्वं क्रीडसि, तथा तद्-विषयां मनीषां मयि धेहि इत्य् उत्तरेणान्वयः। — And as you play, so give me the mind about it, is the consequence of the answer.; नाना-शक्त्य्-उपबृंहितं विश्वं विलुम्पन् संहरन्, विविधं सृजन्, बिभ्रत् पालयन्, आत्मना स्वयम् एव आत्मानं ब्रह्मादि-रूपं गृह्णन् क्रीडसि । — You play with the universe, which is expanded by various energies, destroying it, creating it in various ways, carrying it and maintaining it, and assuming the form of Brahmā and others by Yourself.; ऊर्णुते तन्तुभिर् आत्मानम् आच्छादयति ॥२६-२७॥ — It spreads out and covers itself with fibers (26-27).
28.translation: And as you play, so give me the mind about it, is the consequence of the answer. You play with the universe, which is expanded by various energies, destroying it, creating it in various ways, carrying it and maintaining it, and assuming the form of Brahmā and others by Yourself. It spreads out and covers itself with fibers (26-27).

29.word_for_word: तत् किं सृष्टेर् उद्विग्न एव तत्त्व-ज्ञानं प्रार्थयसे ? — That is, do you pray for knowledge of the truth while you are anxious about creation?; नेत्य् आह—भगवता त्वया शिक्षितम् अनुशिष्टम् अतन्द्रितोऽनलसः सन् करिष्यामि । — He replied, “I will do what the Lord has taught me and taught me, without laziness and without laziness.; तर्हि किम् अनेन तत्त्व-ज्ञानेन ? — So what about this knowledge of the truth?; तत्राह—यस्माद् एवम्-भूतात् तवानुग्रहात् प्रजा-सर्गम् ईहमानः कुर्वन्न् अप्य् अहंकारादिभिर् बद्धो न भवेयम् इति ॥२८॥ — There he said, "Because of this, by Thy grace, I shall not be bound by egoism and other desires, even though I am endeavoring to create progeny.
29.translation: That is, do you pray for knowledge of the truth while you are anxious about creation? He replied, “I will do what the Lord has taught me and taught me, without laziness and without laziness. So what about this knowledge of the truth? There he said, "Because of this, by Thy grace, I shall not be bound by egoism and other desires, even though I am endeavoring to create progeny.

30.word_for_word: अवश्यं च मदो भविता, स तु कंचित् कालं मा भूद् इति प्रार्थयते—यावद् इति । — And surely there will be madness, but he prays that it may not be for a while—until.; भो ईश, ते त्वया लौकिकस्य सख्युः सखेवाहं कृतः कर-स्पर्शनादिना ममत्वेन संमानितः सन् प्रजा-सर्ग-रूपे तव परिकर्मणि सेवायां स्थितोऽविक्लवोऽव्याकुल एव यावज् जनं विभजाम्य् उत्तम-मध्यमादि-भेदेन सृजामि, — O Lord, thou hast made me a friend of the worldly friend, honored by the touch of thy hand and other things as mine, and standing in the service of thy others in the form of the creation of the people,; तावत् त्वत्-संमानाद् अहम् अप्य् अजः स्वतन्त्र इति मानिनो मे समुन्नद्ध उत्कटो मदो मा भूत् ॥२९॥ — Meanwhile, because of Thy honour, let there be no aroused pride in me, who think that I am also unborn and independent.
30.translation: And surely there will be madness, but he prays that it may not be for a while—until. O Lord, thou hast made me a friend of the worldly friend, honored by the touch of thy hand and other things as mine, and standing in the service of thy others in the form of the creation of the people, Meanwhile, because of Thy honour, let there be no aroused pride in me, who think that I am also unborn and independent.

31.word_for_word: ज्ञानं शास्त्रोत्थम् । — Knowledge is scriptural.; विज्ञानम् अनुभवः । — Science is experience.; रहस्यं भक्तिः, “सुगोप्यम् अपि वक्ष्यामि” इत्य्-आदि निर्देशात् । — The secret is devotion, from the instruction, “I will tell you even the most secret things.”; तस्य अङ्गं साधनम् ॥३०॥ — The limb of that is the means.
31.translation: Knowledge is scriptural. Science is experience. The secret is devotion, from the instruction, “I will tell you even the most secret things.” The limb of that is the means.

32.word_for_word: ननु त्वद्-दर्शनेऽप्य् असमर्थोऽहं कथं ज्ञानाधिकारी स्याम् ? — Indeed, how can I possess knowledge even if I am unable to see You?; तत्राह—यावान् इति । — There he says, “Yavan.”; यावान् स्वरूपतः । — Yavan in nature.; यथाभावो यादृक्-सत्तावान् । — as the absence of the as-being.; यानि रूपाणि गुणाः कर्माणि च यस्य ॥३१॥ — Whatever forms, qualities and actions he has.
32.translation: Indeed, how can I possess knowledge even if I am unable to see You? There he says, “Yavan.” Yavan in nature. as the absence of the as-being. Whatever forms, qualities and actions he has.

33.word_for_word: एतद् एव सम्यग् उपदिशन् यावान् इत्य् अस्यार्थं स्फुटयति—अहम् इति । — This is exactly what he teaches, and he explains the meaning of this by saying, “I am.”; अहम् एवाग्रे सृष्टेः पूर्वम् आसं स्थितः, नान्यत् किञ्चित्, यत्सत् स्थूलम् असत् सूक्ष्मं परं तयोः कारणं प्रधानम्, तस्याप्य् अन्तर्मुखतया तदा मय्य् एव लीनत्वात् । — I alone existed before creation, and nothing else, whatever is gross and false, subtle and beyond, is the chief cause of both, since even that which is inwardly absorbed in Me at that time.; अहं च तदा आसम् एव केवलं न चान्यद् अकरवम् । — And I was just there then and I didn’t do anything else.; पश्चात् सृष्टेर् अनन्तरम् अप्य् अहम् एवास्मि । — Later, even after creation, I am the same.; यद् एतद् विश्वं तद् अप्य् अहम् अस्मि । — I am also what this universe is.; प्रलये योऽवशिष्येत सोऽप्य् अहम् एव । — I am also the one who will remain in the doomsday.; अनेन चानाद्य्-अनन्तत्वाद् अद्वितीयत्वाच् च परिपूर्णोऽहम् इत्य् उक्तं भवति ॥३२॥ — This also means that because I am beginningless, infinite and unique, I am perfect.
33.translation: This is exactly what he teaches, and he explains the meaning of this by saying, “I am.” I alone existed before creation, and nothing else, whatever is gross and false, subtle and beyond, is the chief cause of both, since even that which is inwardly absorbed in Me at that time. And I was just there then and I didn’t do anything else. Later, even after creation, I am the same. I am also what this universe is. I am also the one who will remain in the doomsday. This also means that because I am beginningless, infinite and unique, I am perfect.

34.word_for_word: यथात्म-माया-योगेनेत्य् अनेन मायाया अपि पृष्टत्वाद् वक्ष्यमाणोपयोगित्वाच् च मायां निरूपयति । — By saying, “By the combination of illusion of the Self,” he describes illusion, since it is also asked about illusion and because it is useful to be described.; ऋते अर्थं विनापि वास्तवम् अर्थं यद् यतः किम् अप्य् अनिरुक्तम् आत्मन्य् अधिष्ठाने प्रतीयेत सद् अपि च न प्रतीयेत, तद् आत्मनो मम मायां विद्यात् । — Except for the real meaning, even without the meaning, that which is perceived as being in the Self, which is not expressed, and which is not perceived as good, should be known as My illusion of the Self.; यथा आभासो द्वि-चन्द्रादिर् इत्य् अर्थं विना प्रतीतौ दृष्टान्तः । — For example, an illustration is an illustration of perception without meaning, such as two moons.; यथा तम इति सतोऽप्रतीतौ । — For example, darkness is the unperceived truth.; तमो राहुर् यथा ग्रह-मण्डले स्थितोऽपि न दृश्यते तथा ॥३३॥ — Just as Rahu is invisible even though he is situated in the orbit of the planets
34.translation: By saying, “By the combination of illusion of the Self,” he describes illusion, since it is also asked about illusion and because it is useful to be described. Except for the real meaning, even without the meaning, that which is perceived as being in the Self, which is not expressed, and which is not perceived as good, should be known as My illusion of the Self. For example, an illustration is an illustration of perception without meaning, such as two moons. For example, darkness is the unperceived truth. Just as Rahu is invisible even though he is situated in the orbit of the planets

35.word_for_word: यथाभाव इत्य् एतत् स्पष्टयति । — This explains the absence of as it is.; यथा महाभूतानि भौतिकेष्व् अनु सृष्टेर् अनन्तरं प्रविष्टानि तेषूपलभ्यमानत्वात् । — Just as the great beings entered into the material world after creation, because they are perceived in them.; अप्रविष्टानि च प्राग् एव कारणतया तेषु विद्यमानत्वात् । — and they have not entered, since they already exist in them for a reason.; तथा तेषु भूतभौतिकेष्व् अहं न च तेष्व् अहम् । — Similarly, I am in those physical beings, and I am not in them.; एवंभूता मम सत्तेत्य् अर्थः ॥३४॥ — This means that My being is thus formed.
35.translation: This explains the absence of as it is. Just as the great beings entered into the material world after creation, because they are perceived in them. and they have not entered, since they already exist in them for a reason. Similarly, I am in those physical beings, and I am not in them. This means that My being is thus formed.

36.word_for_word: साधनम् आह । — The means is argued.; आत्मनस् तत्त्व-जिज्ञासुना एतावत्त्वम् एव जिज्ञास्यं विचार्यम् । — A person who is inquiring about the truth of the Self should consider this very thing to be inquired about.; तद् एवाह । — That’s what he said.; अन्वयः कार्येषु कारणत्वेनानुवृत्तिः । — Conclusion: Inversion as a cause in actions.; कारणावस्थायां च तेभ्यो व्यतिरेकः । — and in the state of cause, there is a difference between them.; तथा जाग्रद्-आद्य्-अवस्थासु तत्-तत्-साक्षितयान्वयः । — Similarly, in the states of waking and others, there is a consequence of that which is witnessed.; व्यतिरेकश् च समाध्य्-आदौ । — and the difference in the beginning of the meditation.; एवम् अन्वय-व्यतिरेकाभ्यां यत् स्यात् सर्वत्र सर्वदा च तद् एवात्मेति ॥३५॥ — Thus, by both consequence and difference, that which exists everywhere and at all times is the Self.
36.translation: The means is argued. A person who is inquiring about the truth of the Self should consider this very thing to be inquired about. That’s what he said. Conclusion: Inversion as a cause in actions. and in the state of cause, there is a difference between them. Similarly, in the states of waking and others, there is a consequence of that which is witnessed. and the difference in the beginning of the meditation. Thus, by both consequence and difference, that which exists everywhere and at all times is the Self.

37.word_for_word: यत् प्रार्थितं “नेहमानः प्रजासर्गम्” इति तत् प्रसादीकरोति । — He grants what is prayed for, “Nehman created the people.”; एतन् मतं सम्यग् अनुतिष्ठ । — Follow this opinion properly.; समाधिना चित्तैकाग्र्येण । — By meditation and concentration of mind.; कल्पेषु ये विकल्पा विविधाः सृष्टयः, तेषु विमोऽहं कर्तृत्वाभिनिवेशं न यास्यतीति ॥३६॥ — In the various alternatives of creation in the Kalpas, I shall not attain to concentration on the doer, for I am free from them.
37.translation: He grants what is prayed for, “Nehman created the people.” Follow this opinion properly. By meditation and concentration of mind. In the various alternatives of creation in the Kalpas, I shall not attain to concentration on the doer, for I am free from them.

38.word_for_word: एवं सम्प्रदिश्योपदिश्य । — Thus, by teaching and instructing.; जनानां परमेष्ठिनं परमे आधिपत्ये स्थितं ब्रह्माणम् । — The Supreme Lord of all beings, the Supreme Lord, is situated in the Supreme Lord.; आत्मनस् तद्-रूपं न्यरुणद् अन्तर्हितवान् ॥३७॥ — He covered that form of himself and disappeared.
38.translation: Thus, by teaching and instructing. The Supreme Lord of all beings, the Supreme Lord, is situated in the Supreme Lord. He covered that form of himself and disappeared.

39.word_for_word: अन्तर्हित इन्द्रियार्थः प्रत्यक्ष-रूपं येन तस्मै बद्धाञ्जलिः सन् ॥३८॥ — With folded palms he offered obeisances to Him by whom the objects of the senses are hidden in His manifest form.
39.translation: With folded palms he offered obeisances to Him by whom the objects of the senses are hidden in His manifest form.

40.word_for_word: तद्-अनन्तरं पूर्वोक्तो ब्रह्म-नारद-संवादः प्रवृत्त इत्य् आह—प्रजापतिर् इति पञ्चभिः । — After that, the aforementioned dialogue between Brahma and Nārada began, he argues, with five of them, namely, Prajapati.; प्रजानां भद्रम् अन्विच्छन् विमृशन् । — They sought and considered the welfare of the people.; सैव स्वार्थे काम्या स्व-प्रयोजनेच्छा तया यम-नियमान् अन्वतिष्ठत् ॥३९॥ — That very desire for selfishness and for her own purpose followed the rules of Yama.
40.translation: After that, the aforementioned dialogue between Brahma and Nārada began, he argues, with five of them, namely, Prajapati. They sought and considered the welfare of the people. That very desire for selfishness and for her own purpose followed the rules of Yama.

41.word_for_word: रिक्थादानां पुत्राणां मध्ये प्रियतमस् तं पितरं सेवमानः शीलादिना परितोषयामासेत्य् उत्तरेणान्वयः ॥४०॥ — The consequence of the latter is that he who was the dearest among his sons who gave riches served his father and satisfied him by virtue of his virtue and other virtues.
41.translation: The consequence of the latter is that he who was the dearest among his sons who gave riches served his father and satisfied him by virtue of his virtue and other virtues.

42.word_for_word: किम् इच्छन् विष्णोर् मायां विविदिषन् ॥४१॥ — What do they desire, knowing the illusory power of Visnu?
42.translation: What do they desire, knowing the illusory power of Visnu?

43.word_for_word: निशाम्य दृष्ट्वा ज्ञात्वेत्य् अर्थः । — It means to hear, to see, to know.; मा माम् ॥४२॥ — Do not me.
43.translation: It means to hear, to see, to know. Do not me.

44.word_for_word: भगवता चतुः-श्लोक्या संक्षेपेण प्रोक्तं विस्तरेण प्राह । — The Lord explained in detail what He had briefly said in four verses.; दश-लक्षणानि लक्षणीया अर्था विद्यन्ते यस्मिंस् तत् ॥४३॥ — That in which there are ten characteristics and characteristic meanings.
44.translation: The Lord explained in detail what He had briefly said in four verses. That in which there are ten characteristics and characteristic meanings.

45.word_for_word: तत् सम्प्रदायतो भागवतं मया ज्ञातम् इत्य् आशयेनाह—नारद इति ॥४४॥ — With the intention of imparting that knowledge to me, he said, “Nārada.”
45.translation: With the intention of imparting that knowledge to me, he said, “Nārada.”

46.word_for_word: भागवत-व्याख्यानेनैव त्वत्-प्रश्नानाम् उत्तरं दास्यामीत्य् आह—यद् उतेति । — I shall answer your questions by the explanation of the Bhagavad-gītā, he said.; पुरुषावयवैर्लोकाः स-पालाः पूर्व-कल्पिताः इत्य्-आदिना वैराजात् पुरुषाद् इदं विश्वं कथम् आसीद् इति यद् अहं त्वया पृष्टः तद् यथावद् उपाख्यास्यामि शृण्व् इति ॥४५॥ — I shall explain to you in detail what you have asked me about how this universe came into existence from the Supreme Personality of Godhead, Vairāja, by the Supreme Personality of Godhead, who created the worlds and their rulers in the beginning. Please hear me.
46.translation: I shall answer your questions by the explanation of the Bhagavad-gītā, he said. I shall explain to you in detail what you have asked me about how this universe came into existence from the Supreme Personality of Godhead, Vairāja, by the Supreme Personality of Godhead, who created the worlds and their rulers in the beginning. Please hear me.
